title: Comfort Club Member Deposit Rates on Replacement System Installations
content:
# Member deposit rate

**Rule.** The deposit rate of a Replacement System Installations contract deposit follows the homeowner's Comfort Club agreement, as held in the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements records:

| Comfort Club agreement | Deposit rate on the net price |
|---|---|
| Active, on the Comfort Club Platinum, Comfort Club Platinum Plus or Comfort Club Total Home tier | 8 percent |
| Active, on any other tier | 12 percent |
| No agreement in active status | The package's deposit percentage |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical homeowners)

- An active agreement on Comfort Club Platinum Plus: 8 percent of the net price.
- An active agreement on Comfort Club Gold: 12 percent of the net price.
- An active agreement on Comfort Club Basic: 12 percent of the net price — any tier other than the three named is the 12 percent row.
- A past-due agreement on Comfort Club Total Home: not in active status, so the package's deposit percentage.
- No Comfort Club agreement at all: the package's deposit percentage.
